bug_fixed.description: SUMÁRIO page numbers were not visible because of incorrect unit conversion
bug_fixed.root_cause: The formula '(page_width / 28.35) * 72' was treating page_width as mm, but it's already in points. This resulted in x position ~1500 (off the page) instead of ~550.
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed to 'page_width - content_right - 15' which correctly calculates the right margin position in points.
